doc.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

chapter: Early road bands and the Army
title: Backing Nat Cole and Mel Torme at Lake Tahoe
summary: At twenty he backed Nat Cole, Mel Torme and lesser acts at Tahoe.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well you got a little taste of it, you know, big band, you were what 20 years old?

Yeah. Twenty years old and we also played behind, you know Nat Cole came in for three weeks, Mel Torme, and we backed them up and we got to know them pretty well, and I mean just playing behind Nat for three weeks was worth the whole summer actually for me. And some acts that were not so enduring like Gogi Grant maybe and people of that — good but not the kind that are going to last forever.
